detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training. Quests will have you face off against electric slimes, rock-hurling crabs, towering dungeon bosses, and other dangerous creatures in strategic top-down combat. Meet other players on their own adventure and team up against powerful foes, race for valuable treasure, or even clash in optional faction-based PvP combat. After an adventure, head back to the Town Square to hang out, upgrade gear, show off your look, fish with friends, and prepare for your next expedition. Meet other online knights, squad up, and jump back into the action together! There’s nothing like clucking around with friends. Complete quests to earn gems, crafting materials, and rare loot. Forge powerful weapons, craft sturdy armor, upgrade your equipment, and experiment with new builds that fit your personal combat style. The more you explore, the stronger your knight becomes. Key Features Online Co-Op Adventure: Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players in a shared online world. Action Combat: Master a variety of unique weapons and abilities to overcome enemies. Dungeon Diving: Enter Zelda-like dungeons to solve puzzles, find secrets, and challenge bosses! Town Square: A place to socialize, upgrade gear, fish, and party up before the next quest. PvP Factions: Opt into PvP by joining a faction! Battle other players in chaotic faction warfare.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

Quests will have you face off against electric slimes, rock-hurling crabs, towering dungeon bosses, and other dangerous creatures in strategic top-down combat. Meet other players on their own adventure and team up against powerful foes, race for valuable treasure, or even clash in optional faction-based PvP combat.

After an adventure, head back to the Town Square to hang out, upgrade gear, show off your look, fish with friends, and prepare for your next expedition. Meet other online knights, squad up, and jump back into the action together! There’s nothing like clucking around with friends.


Complete quests to earn gems, crafting materials, and rare loot. Forge powerful weapons, craft sturdy armor, upgrade your equipment, and experiment with new builds that fit your personal combat style. The more you explore, the stronger your knight becomes.

Key Features

  • Online Co-Op Adventure: Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players in a shared online world.

  • Action Combat: Master a variety of unique weapons and abilities to overcome enemies.

  • Dungeon Diving: Enter Zelda-like dungeons to solve puzzles, find secrets, and challenge bosses!

  • Town Square: A place to socialize, upgrade gear, fish, and party up before the next quest.

  • PvP Factions: Opt into PvP by joining a faction! Battle other players in chaotic faction warfare.
